_meta.purpose: re-validate on iree-base 3.13.0 the loop/scan/while-in-cond/MO-class shapes recorded as broken on 3.11.0 (adapters CONTEXT Known Issues 8f/10, PER-ADAPTER-NOTES Known Issue 10)
_meta.gpu: AMD Instinct MI300X VF (iree hip device_id 1)
_meta.shared_host_caveat: the ROCm GPU is SHARED with other work on this box: timings are a single sequential process per cell (never two timers at once) but must be read as indicative, not isolated-hardware numbers; correctness/compile-crash results are unaffected
_meta.timing: each sample = evoxc.run + Executable.synchronize(); warm = median and best of 10 samples after 3 warmups
_meta.parity: per leaf, max |got - ref| and max |got - ref| / max|ref| against a hand-written numpy oracle (independent of the evoxc numpy backend); 'all_bit_exact' over every leaf
_meta.compile_repeats: the two compile-crash cells are compiled compile_repeats times per target in SEPARATE processes; a non-zero exit is recorded verbatim (-11 = SIGSEGV, -6 = SIGABRT), never retried away
_meta.host_caveat_note: one timing process at a time; EVOXC_DISABLE_LOCATIONS=1
